name: Santpedor (Spain)
description: Green field with the last vertical third bearing four red pales on yellow, charged on the green with two keys in pale, yellow and white, the attribute of Saint Peter.
history: The official flag of Santpedor (published 18 November 2003) is an oblong flag of 2:3, green, with the last vertical third bearing the four bars of Catalonia, which recall the royal jurisdiction over the town, a 'street of Barcelona' by grant of Martin I in 1400, and the keys of Saint Peter, patron of the town, taken from the arms approved on 22 September 1995.
